cohort: The study involved 189 women aged 18-45 years presenting with Abnormal Uterine Bleeding (AUB) and having at least one prior Caesarean Section.
finding: Caesarean Scar Defects were associated with Abnormal Uterine Bleeding in 4.2% of cases with prior Caesarean Section, with women having two or more caesarean deliveries showing a substantially higher CSD association (12.2%) compared to those with a single caesarean section (1.4%).
mod_finding: Women with two or more caesarean deliveries exhibited a substantially higher Caesarean Scar Defect association (12.2%) compared to those with a single caesarean section (1.4%), indicating a relationship between the number of C-sections and the outcome.
